a full three-component derivative Class-II Gibbs or constructive measure

The corrected and PUBLISHED A4 v2.1 support bundle is a hash-pinned premise.
The theorem retains tau>0 and restarted exact-Galerkin scope instead of silently asserting t=0 rates.
Requires ultraviolet power counting, derivative-current definition, counterterms, stability, and regulator removal for the full three-component functional.
The scalar and full-production mass anchors remain distinct and no common calibrated parameter theorem exists.
eta_shell nonzero and removal of rho or Class-II mass regularisers are not covered.
P3 gives controlled positive-time exact-Galerkin convergence, not practical N32/N64/N128 historical-solver error bars.
Only the canonical spectral regulator and exact-Galerkin route are proved.
A4 is finite volume and supplies neither thermodynamic-limit construction nor phase selection.
BCC existence, minimization, stability, and Sector-B selection remain outside Sector-A conditional composition.

promotion_rule: A fresh integrated PASS and exact PDF review are necessary but insufficient. T6 is enacted only after explicit operator confirmation; the PUBLISHED T6 bundle is built last and the T5 bundle remains immutable.
